headline: Sophia Genetics misses Q3 EPS estimates despite beating revenue forecasts
summary: Sophia Genetics reported third-quarter earnings missing consensus estimates by $0.06 while exceeding revenue expectations.
why: Biotech and genomic data companies rely on top-line growth to validate commercial adoption while monitoring bottom-line profitability burn rates.
